decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation is a recently launched complement to the firm's marking portfolio, and machinery firms rarely withdraw such products within a year of launch, though it gets less website prominence than the printers.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer has its own product page, which signals strategic importance, and it serves steady coding and marking demand in packaging and industry.
The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is prominently presented and fills a distinct application niche next to the thermal inkjet line, so dropping it soon after launch is unlikely.
